scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run seed
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:setup && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:setup: test -n "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" || (echo 'Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a scratch Postgres database (a Neon branch works). It is wiped on every run.' && exit 1) && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" PIN_PEPPER="test-pepper-not-used-anywhere-real-0123456789abcdef" tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
